BRAND IDENTITY / PORTFOLIO PROJECT

Antelope Constructions

A confident construction identity, built to work from the boardroom to the building site.

DESIGNER / ODUSINA ISAACDISCIPLINE / BRAND IDENTITYVIEW THE PROJECT GALLERY ↓

Context

The project shows a construction company’s identity across office, site and business materials.

Visual direction

A geometric antelope emblem pairs with a restrained wordmark. Gold, charcoal and cream create a consistent visual direction.

Design decisions

The same mark moves from stationery to safety equipment and site signage. Architectural photography supports the brochure and website layouts.

Applications

The gallery contains the overview, office signage, website presentation, brochure, stationery, safety gear and site branding.
